description: An Imperial muted plum floor-length gown over a cream linen underdress, with a low square neckline, naturally fitted opaque bodice and elbow sleeves. Narrow gold geometric woven borders run along neckline, waist, cuffs, front and hem. A refined belt with small round clasps and a cream wrap edged in plum-gold rest at the waist and along the arms. Small gold earrings and pendant necklace, a modest walking opening and decorated gold flats complete the attire.
